content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing a similar issue. When using the [company_name] Ethernet connection, the web server works, but I can't connect through the [product_name] configuration software and nothing functions with the GENERIC or Layer2 settings. Do you enter only the IP address or also the gateway information? Regards, [user_name]
Hello, could you provide more details? For example: • Version of [product_name] configuration software • Device article number • Any relevant screenshots. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faces problems connecting to their automation device with [product_name] configuration software. Web server access via [company_name] Ethernet is successful, but connection through the configuration software fails when using GENERIC and Layer2 options. User expresses frustration regarding unclear instructions for network setup, especially concerning IP and gateway entry requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy and clear network setup process within [product_name] configuration software. They are seeking precise guidance on connection parameters (IP, gateway), and would like device connectivity through the software to match the reliability experienced when using the web server.
